Candy Co – Cleaning Inspection Report

Line: Sollich 1
Finding: Possible Moisture at Tunnel 1 Head

During the continuation of the Sollich 1 cleaning process, with only Tunnel 1 remaining to be cleaned, signs of possible moisture were detected in the area at the beginning of the tunnel head.

Observations:

	●	Traces of moisture were found on the refrigeration filter located in front of the building windows, at the beginning of Tunnel 1.
	●	Damp dust was observed underneath the conveyor belt at the beginning of the tunnel, near the tunnel head.

Status: The finding is being reported for further inspection to determine the possible source of moisture and ensure proper cleaning and sanitary conditions before the area is released.
Mid shift  Marcos Montano
